title: Correlation Clustering with Random Partial Information
abstract: arXiv:2608.16315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Correlation clustering is a fundamental unsupervised learning problem. On complete graphs, both the min-disagreement and min-max objectives admit constant-factor approximations, yet on general (non-complete) graphs, the best guarantees blow up to $O(\log n)$ and $O(\sqrt{n})$. This gap between the two regimes motivates the following question: are there classes of incomplete graphs that circumvent the lower bounds on general graphs and admit approximation guarantees approaching those attainable on complete graphs? We study a natural class of graphs obtained by randomly subsampling a complete signed graph $G$, where each edge is independently deleted with probability $q$. For such graph instances both for the min-max and the min-disagreement objectives, we prove approximation guarantees (depending on $q$) that are substantially better than the bounds achievable for general graphs. translated_title: 随机部分信息下的相关性聚类
translated_abstract: 相关性聚类是一个基本的无监督学习问题。在完全图上，最小分歧和最小最大目标均具有常数因子近似，但在一般（非完全）图上，最佳保证恶化至$O(\log n)$和$O(\sqrt{n})$。这两种情况之间的差距引发了以下问题：是否存在某些不完全图类别能够规避一般图上的下界，并获得接近完全图上可实现的近似保证？我们研究了一类自然图，即通过对一个完全符号图$G$进行随机子采样获得，其中每条边以概率$q$独立删除。对于此类图实例，无论是最小最大目标还是最小分歧目标，我们都证明了（依赖于$q$的）近似保证，这些保证显著优于一般图可实现的上界。我们还通过实验补充了理论结果。
tldr: 本文证明在随机子采样的不完全符号图上，相关性聚类的近似保证可显著优于一般图，逼近完全图的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that on randomly subsampled incomplete signed graphs, correlation clustering approximation guarantees can significantly outperform general graphs, approaching complete graph performance.
